text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san. Alles Gute— Happy birthday 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of baking some sweets as a 
gift for you. Do you have any requests?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Then... A "superposition" of 
cookies and chocolate. ...Because they're 
always "delicious."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Always...? Are you referring to the 
cookies I leave in the dorm dining hall 
for everyone to enjoy?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... So Universe-san has enjoyed 
eating it as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Checking every day to see if 
they're there. No matter how much I eat, I 
never reach "saturation"...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Fufu, I did think those 
cookies disappeared rather quickly back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, should I say "I'm sorry"...? I ended 
up eating so many slices all by myself...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"No, quite the opposite, I'm delighted! 
Having someone appreciate it that much is 
the greatest joy a creator could ask for."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I shall put my heart and soul into baking 
the gift cookies. Be sure to keep them all 
to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Having it all to ourselves...! The "Big 
Bang" is amazing... It feels like... a 
"dream."
